answer: none — no meteg is printed in ומצילנו in this snippet
visible_evidence: The whole word and its lower points are visible. Under the mem there is a single plain horizontal patach bar with no vertical stroke beside it. Under the tsadi (which has a dagesh) there is one dot, a hiriq. The yod has no mark under it. Under the lamed there are two side-by-side dots, a tsere. The nun has no mark under it. The final vav has its shuruk dot inside, at the left. There is no short vertical stroke under any letter. The descender of the lamed belongs to the letter itself, and the ink from the next line is well below the vowel area, so neither can be mistaken for a meteg.
